infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FieldReportX uses the camera to capture inspection, evidence, and verification photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FieldReportX needs access to your photos to attach inspection images and screenshots.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddOnlyUsageDescription: FieldReportX needs permission to save inspection photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FieldReportX uses your location to geotag photos, track GPS routes, and verify report locations.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: FieldReportX uses motion sensors to analyse driving smoothness and patient movement.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FieldReportX uses the microphone to record audio evidence and witness statements.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FieldReportX uses speech recognition to transcribe voice notes and field reports.
